sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next - GitHub
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next features a 125B -parameter main model, supplemented by an additional 51B N-gram embeddings, with 6B parameters activated per token. Compared with Qwen3.7-Plus, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next substantially reduces both training and inference cost — training takes only about 1/9 as much, yet it delivers superior capabilities in coding and office tasks.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: How to Run Locally - unsloth.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is a new open-weight, 125B parameter MoE multimodal model from Qwen. Built on the new Qwen4 architecture, it supports a 262K context window and advanced reasoning.

sources.title: Qwen3.8 | OpenLM.ai
sources.snippet: We are officially releasing Qwen 3.8-Max, the most capable model in the Qwen family to date. This also marks the first time we will open-source the weights of a Qwen-Max-class model. Built upon the architectural foundation of Qwen 3.5, Qwen 3.8-Max scales to 2.4 trillion parameters, delivering comprehensive improvements across coding, work, research, and long-horizon tasks.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash - QwenCloud
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash is the latest multimodal model from the Qwen family, combining powerful reasoning and generation with remarkable speed. It natively supports a million-token context window, allowing it to process lengthy documents, entire codebases, and complex conversations in a single pass.

sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is a multimodal, ultra-sparse Mixture-of-Experts model. It has 125B parameters, including an additional 51B N-gram embedding table, while activating 6B parameters per token. The architecture combines four main ideas: GDN + QSA: three of every four layers use Gated DeltaNet to compress history; the fourth uses Qwen Sparse Attention for precise long-range retrieval ...
